headline: Easy breeding chain: Quivern
title: Easy Quivern Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Three breeds, and you have Quivern. Here is the full Palworld breeding chain. Step one: breed Incineram with Kitsun to get Felbat. Step two: breed that Felbat with Relaxaurus to get Mammorest. Step three: breed Mammorest with Relaxaurus, and the egg hatches into Quivern! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Quivern: Incineram + Kitsun = Felbat, Felbat + Relaxaurus = Mammorest, Mammorest + Relaxaurus = Quivern. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
